name: io.github.Saidwire/saidwire-mcp
title: Saidwire Speech-to-Text
description: Transcribe local audio files and public audio URLs to text, SRT/VTT or word timestamps.

environmentVariables.name: SAIDWIRE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Saidwire API key (free key with 120 hours at https://saidwire.com/dev)

environmentVariables.name: SAIDWIRE_MAX_DOWNLOAD_MB
environmentVariables.description: Size limit in MB for transcribe_url downloads (default 100)
